evidence.title: 5 things civil rights data says about public schools

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Department 2023-24 CRDC release files and First Look Report
occurrences.quote_span: When it finally did share the information on Aug. 31, collected from over 97,000 public schools, it was without a usual "First Look Report" that makes the information easier to understand for the public.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Dan Losen research on school-district suspension reasons
occurrences.quote_span: His research shows that most districts suspend students for what he calls minor offenses rather than unsafe behavior.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Losen
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Research on Black teachers and Black student educational outcomes
occurrences.quote_span: Black students have better achievement, better school discipline outcomes, and a whole host of other outcomes when they're taught by Black teachers.
occurrences.speaker: Maithreyi Gopalan
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection staff and student demographic tables
occurrences.quote_span: And the teacher workforce was far less diverse than the student population.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection enrollment tables
occurrences.quote_span: The number of kids in preschool rose in the 2023-24 school year, while those in K-12 public schools declined.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection discipline tables
occurrences.quote_span: Black students were more likely to be suspended than students of other races.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 CRDC reporting requirements and Education Department instructions
occurrences.quote_span: Under President Joe Biden, the CRDC required schools to report the experiences of nonbinary students for the first time.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: National Institute for Early Education Research state-funded pre-K enrollment report
occurrences.quote_span: According to the National Institute for Early Education Research, state-funded pre-K enrollment rose nearly 15% between 2021-22 and 2023-24.
occurrences.speaker: National Institute for Early Education Research
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: federal school mental-health-services survey data
occurrences.quote_span: Notably, nearly 7 out of 10 public schools reported an increase in students seeking mental health services since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, according to other federal data.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Research and CRDC data on AP access and postsecondary opportunity for students with disabilities
occurrences.quote_span: These are all gateways to college, other opportunities beyond high school. And we see gaps in opportunity and access for students with disabilities.
occurrences.speaker: Maithreyi Gopalan
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection K-12 enrollment tables
occurrences.quote_span: At the same time, K-12 enrollment fell almost 1% compared with the 2021-22 school year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection disability enrollment tables
occurrences.quote_span: While the previous CRDC showed 17% of students had disabilities, the newest data show they made up 19% of all students enrolled in public schools.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Historical Civil Rights Data Collection releases and Dan Losen’s CRDC research record
occurrences.quote_span: "There is no Civil Rights Data Collection where they intentionally collected data and then just suppressed it," says Losen, who has been analyzing the CRDC for more than 25 years.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Losen
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2021-22 and 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection suspension tables
occurrences.quote_span: That's up by about 100,000 students in each category compared with the last report from 2021-22.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection staff demographic questionnaire and prior CRDC documentation
occurrences.quote_span: For the first time since the 1970s, the latest CRDC gathered information about teachers' race, ethnicity and sex.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection discipline tables by disability status
occurrences.quote_span: And they were suspended out of school at disproportionately high rates.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Department 2023-24 CRDC First Look Report publication record
occurrences.quote_span: Now, that too, is available.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: California 2023-24 preschool and transitional kindergarten enrollment records
occurrences.quote_span: For example, in 2023-24, California was in its second year of expanding its universal transitional kindergarten (TK) program for 4-year-olds, and the state enrolled nearly 36,000 more children in preschool or TK than the year before.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection AP enrollment tables by disability status
occurrences.quote_span: Disabled students are also among the least likely groups to be enrolled in Advanced Placement (AP) classes in high school.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Dan Losen suspension-days research
occurrences.quote_span: Losen's research shows that about a decade ago, students were losing out on 11 million days of school because of suspensions.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Losen
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection suspension tables
occurrences.quote_span: The number of students who were suspended increased across the board: 2.5 million students were punished with one or more out-of-school suspensions while 2.3 million students faced in-school suspensions in 2023-24.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection disability enrollment tables
occurrences.quote_span: The population of students with disabilities grew.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Department CRDC release decision and cited executive order
occurrences.quote_span: The information was collected for the 2023-24 school year, but the Trump administration chose not to release it, citing an executive order that called for the federal government to "recognize two sexes, male and female."
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection summary and enrollment data
occurrences.quote_span: The findings are about 49.7 million public school students and include data on enrollment, harassment and the treatment of students with disabilities, among other things.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: UCLA analysis of transgender identification among U.S. children ages 13 to 17
occurrences.quote_span: According to one UCLA analysis, about 3% of children ages 13 to 17 identify as transgender nationwide, which includes nonbinary youth.
occurrences.speaker: UCLA analysis
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection teacher workforce demographic tables
occurrences.quote_span: It found that the workforce is 75% white, 9% Black and 11% Latino — a drastically different makeup than the students they serve.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Civil Rights Data Collection historical records and Education Department program documentation
occurrences.quote_span: The federal government has been gathering this kind of information for over 50 years, partly to help the U.S. Education Department hold schools accountable for protecting student civil rights.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Department of Education emailed statement to NPR
occurrences.quote_span: In an emailed statement, the Education Department did not answer NPR's questions about its decision to withhold data on nonbinary students, instead highlighting the Trump administration's priority to collect data about sexual offenses on school campuses.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Department of Education
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection preschool enrollment tables
occurrences.quote_span: Some 1.5 million children were enrolled in public preschool programs — a 12% jump from the 2021-22 school year, but still slightly lower than 2019.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection suspension-days data by race
occurrences.quote_span: Another persistent pattern with school discipline is who faces it: Losen says the latest data show that Black students lost over four times as many days of school compared to white peers because of out-of-school suspension.
occurrences.speaker: Dan Losen
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection disability enrollment demographic tables
occurrences.quote_span: The population of students with disabilities is on the rise, and boys make up a much bigger share than girls — nearly two-thirds — of these students.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Education Department CRDC publication timeline and announcement
occurrences.quote_span: The Trump administration published the latest CRDC from the 2023-24 school year six months later than promised.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: Research on certified and experienced teachers, counselors and educational outcomes
occurrences.quote_span: Research shows that access to certified and experienced teachers and to counselors has a positive effect on who finishes high school, who graduates, and who goes on to colleges," Gopalan says.
occurrences.speaker: Maithreyi Gopalan
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection teacher certification and student demographic tables
occurrences.quote_span: Yet, more than 720,000 students go to schools where fewer than half of teachers met state certification requirements, and Black and Latino students make up 73% of those students.
occurrences.speaker: Maithreyi Gopalan
occurrences.subject: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection

occurrences.checkable_against: 2023-24 Civil Rights Data Collection suspension-days data
occurrences.quote_span: According to the latest CRDC, he says they missed over 14 million days in the 2023-24 school year.
